source: 679 Spirit Medium
target: 679 Medium Spiritus

source: Seeing Robert, clad in ice armor and dragging a frost scythe, sprinting towards the stained‐glass window facing him, Rhea, and Lugano, Camus immediately drew his custom‐made revolver and aimed it ahead.
target: Cum Robertum videret, indutum lorica glaciali et falcem glacialem trahebantem, festinanter currentem versus vitrum pictum, quod ad eum, Rheam, et Lugano spectabat, Camus statim revolverum suum proprium confectum extraxit atque ante se destinavit.

source: At that moment, his feet turned cold, and his body froze, causing his joints to become sluggish and his wrists to tremble.
target: Illo momento, pedes eius frigidi facti sunt et corpus eius congelatum est, quae effecit ut articulationes eius inertes fierent et carpi tremarent.

source: From the corner of his eye, Camus observed that although Robert hadn’t truly approached, the frost on the ground and the icicles on the wall had already reached him.
target: Ex angulo oculi sui, Camus animadvertit quod, quamquam Robertus re vera non accessisset, glacies in solo et spicula glaciei super parietem iam ad eum pervenerant.

source: Within a radius of ten to twenty meters, the chill intensified, resembling the extreme north.
target: In radio decem ad viginti metrorum, frigus intensum factum est, instar septentrionis extremi apparens.

source: With a swoosh, Rhea shot another arrow entwined with silver lightning.
target: Cum sonitu, Rhea aliam sagittam iaculata est, quae fulgore argenteo involuta erat.

source: Robert didn’t dodge or evade.
target: Robertus neque declinavit neque evasit.

source: Exerting strength in his arms, he swung the frosty scythe forward.
target: Fortitudinem in brachiis adhibens, falcem glacialem in antea propulit.

source: Clang!
target: Clang!

source: The scythe knocked away the arrow, leaving behind a small amount of lightning that raced towards Robert’s body.
target: Falx sagittam aberavit, relinquens parvam quantitatem fulgoris quae ad corpus Roberti properabat.

source: Amidst the sizzling sounds, Robert felt numb for a moment before continuing to sprint towards Rhea and the others.
target: Inter sonos crepitantes, Robertus per momentum se insensibilem sensit, antequam currere versus Rheam et reliquos perseveraret.

source: Camus was taken aback.
target: Camus stupefactus est.

source: He wasn’t surprised that Robert could control the frost scythe so effortlessly and create a considerable frozen domain.
target: Non miratus est quod Robertus falcem glacialem tam facile moderari posset atque spatium congelatum ingens creare.

source: Instead, he was surprised that Robert had rushed up to him and was about to enter a five‐meter range.
target: Sed potius stupuit quod Robertus ad eum festinanter accessisset et intra spatium quinque metrorum imminere pararet.

source: Doesn’t he know about my Psychic Piercing ability?
target: Nonne novit de facultate mea perforationis psychicae?

source: Doesn’t he realize that Psychic Piercing’s effective range is five meters?
target: Nonne intellegit quod radius perforationis psychicae efficax quinque metrorum sit?

source: Could it be that he has never encountered or fought a Mid‐Sequence Beyonder of the Arbiter pathway?
target: Numquamne obvenit aut pugnatus est cum Beyonder mediocris ex via Arbiter?

source: That’s true, Camus thought.
target: Ita vero, Camus cogitavit.

source: No one in the patrol team or the Admiral Guard knows that Robert and Miss Amandina are Beyonders.
target: Nemo in manipulo vigiliae aut in Custodia Admirali novit Robertum et Dominam Amandinam Beyonder esse.

source: After obtaining Beyonder powers during the Dream Festival, they probably don’t use them much in the outside world.
target: Postquam potentias Beyonder consecuti sunt durante Festa Somniorum, verisimiliter ea in mundo extra parum utuntur.

source: They can only unleash their full potential during the annual Dream Festival.
target: Solum in annuo Festa Somniorum suam plenam potentiam efferre possunt.

source: There aren’t many Beyonder enemies to choose from…
target: Non sunt multi hostes Beyonder eligendi…

source: As these thoughts raced through Camus’s mind, he seized the opportunity.
target: Dum haec cogitationes per mentem Camus volitabant, occasionem ceperat.

source: As Robert stepped within five meters, his eyes lit up with brilliant lightning.
target: Cum Robertus intra spatium quinque metrorum accessit, oculi eius fulgore praeclaro incendebantur.

source: Psychic Piercing!
target: Perforatio Psychica!

source: Two bolts of lightning shot out and pierced Robert’s head.
target: Duo fulmina proiecerunt et caput Roberti transfixerunt.

source: Robert let out a blood‐curdling scream and tumbled forward, writhing in pain.
target: Robertus clamorem terribilem edidit et in antea labens cecidit, dolore se contorquens.

source: He had tossed the frost scythe aside.
target: Falcem glacialem abiecit.

source: Rhea’s arrow was once again nocked to the bowstring, instinctively following Robert’s roll.
target: Sagitta Rhea iterum in chorda arcu inserta erat, instinctu sequens rotam Roberti.

source: Fury blazed in her eyes, erupting from within her body, and her muscles bulged with the surge of power.
target: Ira in oculis eius ardebat, ex intimo corpore erumpens, et musculi eius vi potentiae influxu tumebant.

source: Raging Blow.
target: Ictus Furibundus.

source: This was the Raging Blow Rhea had accumulated through her anger.
target: Hic erat Ictus Furibundus, quem Rhea per suam iram collegit.

source: It came from Sequence 8 Folk of Rage from the Sailor pathway. By releasing accumulated anger, her attack was greatly enhanced.
target: Hic venit ex Sequentione VIII “Populus Irae” via nautarum; iram accumulatam dimittens, impetum eius valde augebat.

source: Rhea was currently at this Sequence, but the hunting bow in her hand was a powerful Beyonder item.
target: Rhea nunc ad hanc sequentiam pertinebat, sed arcus venandi in manu eius rem Beyonder potentem habebat.

source: It was a formidable weapon she had spent all her savings on before arriving in Tizamo.
target: Illud erat arma formidolosum, in quod totam pecuniam suam ante adventum in Tizamo impenderat.

source: It was called Thunderclap Explosion and could be used for two years.
target: Illud appellabatur “Explosio Tonitrui” et per biennium adhiberi poterat.

source: Soon, Robert ceased his tumbling, but he couldn’t shake off the intense pain caused by Psychic Piercing.
target: Mox Robertus labens desiit, sed dolorem intensum, quem Perforatio Psychica attulit, superare non potuit.

source: He froze in place for a moment.
target: Per momentum stetit immobilis.

source: Without hesitation, Rhea watched the arrow, engulfed in dazzling lightning, and released her grip on the bowstring.
target: Sine mora, Rhea sagittam, fulgore splendenti involutam, observavit et manum ab chorda arcu relaxavit.

source: The arrow shot out, but the lightning on it strangely split into two. One continued to ensnare the arrow, while the other darted to the right.
target: Sagitta iecit, sed fulgor in ea mirum modum in duas partes divisus est. Una part continuavit sagittam amplecti, dum altera ad dextram festinavit.

source: Wh– Rhea’s pupils dilated, unable to comprehend why such a thing had occurred.
target: Heu— pupillae Rhea dilatatae sunt, neque poterant comprehendere cur talis res evenisset.

source: Instinctively, she turned her head and followed the separated bolt of lightning to its destination.
target: Instinctu, caput vertit et fulgorem divisum ad metam suam sequens pervenit.

source: Then, she saw Louis Berry leaning against the window, his eyes tightly shut as he slid down.
target: Tum vidit Ludovicum Berry ad fenestram inclinatum, cum oculi eius arcte clausi essent, dum deorsum labebat.

source: A few seconds ago, upon hearing Louis Berry’s words, Amandina had locked onto him with a mix of confusion and excitement.
target: Paucis secundis abhinc, verbis Ludovici Berry auditis, Amandina eum complexa est cum mixtione confusionis et excitamenti.

source: Since you said it, I won’t stand on ceremony!
target: Cum id dixeris, non caerimoniam servabo!

source: In her spiritual perception, Louis Berry’s soul was intertwined with the sinister soul, fiercely resisting while using various parts of his body as a battlefield.
target: In sua perceptione spirituali, anima Ludovici Berry cum anima sinistra intricata erat, vehementer repugnans et diversas partes corporis sui ut campum pugnae adhibens.

source: However, the owner of the body was clearly at a disadvantage.
target: Attamen, dominus corporis manifeste in incommodo erat.

source: Amandina couldn’t separate them under such circumstances.
target: Amandina eos in his condicionibus separare non potuit.

source: She vaguely understood why Louis Berry had instructed her to lock onto the other party’s head and entangled soul with her spirituality.
target: Ea vage intellexit cur Ludovicus Berry eam instruxisset ut caput et animam intricatam adversarii cum sua spiritualitate coniungeret.

source: Lumian, who had Amandina use her abilities, stammered as he struggled to move his left hand in his pocket.
target: Lumian, qui Amandinam ad facultates suas adhibendas provocaverat, titubans conabatur manum sinistram in sinu movere.

source: His left hand wasn’t in his trouser pocket or shirt pocket, but in his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Manus sinistra eius non in sinu braccorum aut vestis erat, sed in sacco Viatoris.

source: After arriving outside Saint-Sien Cathedral and prying open the stained‐glass window, Lumian had inserted his left hand into his Traveler’s Bag, ready to retrieve a suitable mystical item at any moment.
target: Postquam extra Sanctam Sien Cathedralem pervenit et fenestram vitream aperuit, Lumian manum sinistram in sacco Viatoris inseruit, paratus ad rem mysticam idoneam unoquoque momento extrahendam.

source: He was preparing for the impending battle.
target: Se ad proelium imminens praeparabat.

source: If this wasn’t a dream, he would likely have his hand in his left shirt pocket–where Mr. K’s finger was.
target: Si hoc non esset somnium, verisimiliter manum sinistram in sinu tunicae haberet, ubi digitus Domini K positus esset.

source: Before being fully controlled by the Wraith, Lumian relied on the strength of a Reaper’s soul to struggle and retrieve a brooch from his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Priusquam a Wraith plene dominaretur, Lumian vi animae Messoris confidebat ut pugnaretur et fibulam ex sacco Viatoris extraheret.

source: It was the grayish-white, lightning-shaped brooch known as Fury of the Sea!
target: Fibula erat griseo-alba, forma fulminis similis, nota ut “Furor Maris”!

source: Lumian gripped the brooch tightly and observed Amandina leaning against the wall.
target: Lumian fibulam arcte apprehendit et Amandinam contra parietem inclinatum observavit.

source: She clenched her fists and closed her eyes.
target: Manus coniunxit et oculos clausit.

source: His thoughts suddenly blurred, and his eyelids grew heavy.
target: Eius cogitationes subito obscuratae sunt, et palpebra eius gravia facta sunt.

source: He fell asleep and slowly slid down the wall.
target: Dormivit et parietem lente labens descendit.

source: Padre Cali fell silent in his body.
target: Padre Cali in corpore suo tacuit.

source: The Wraith appeared to be asleep as well.
target: Wraith etiam dormire videbatur.

source: It was unknown if he would fall asleep on his own or if he was affected by the negative effect of now possessing a body.
target: Nesciebatur utrum ipse dormiret aut effectu negativo, quod ex corpore nunc possidebat, afficeretur.

source: Amandina opened her eyes and was delighted to see this.
target: Amandina oculos aperuit et hoc videns delectata est.

source: She wanted to praise herself.
target: Se laudare cupiebat.

source: With a crackling sound, the bolt of lightning detached from Rhea’s arrow struck Lumian, transforming into numerous tiny electric serpents that slithered around him.
target: Cum sono crepitante, ictus fulminis a sagitta Rhea separat, Lumian percussit et in innumeros parvos serpentulos electricos qui circa eum labebantur transformatus est.

source: This was the downside of the Fury of the Sea brooch!
target: Hoc erat incommodum fibulae “Furor Maris”!

source: Even if Lumian only carried it, there was a high chance of being struck by lightning when he went out in the rain.
target: Etiam si Lumian solum illud portaret, alta probabilitas erat ut fulmine percussus esset, cum in pluvia exiret.

source: And if he wore it without attacking anyone else, the likelihood of encountering such a thing would significantly increase.
target: Et si illud gereret sine alio aggrediente, verisimilitudo ut talis res occureret significanter augeretur.

source: Lumian believed that since the Fury of the Sea brooch had a chance of attracting lightning strikes on a rainy day, it held a special allure for lightning.
target: Lumian credebat quod, cum fibula “Furor Maris” occasionem haberet ad fulminis ictus in die pluvioso attrahendos, eam peculiarem allicitate fulminis habere.

source: In such a situation, although it wasn’t raining, what if there was another source of lightning nearby? What would happen?
target: In tali re, quamquam non pluviabat, quid, si prope esset alter fons fulminis, eveniret?

source: There was a high chance that it would attract a portion of someone else’s lightning!
target: Alta probabilitas erat ut partem alicuius fulminis attraheret!

source: Stimulated by the pain of the electric shock, Lumian, no longer affected by the Nightmare ability, snapped out of his dream.
target: Ex dolore ictus electrici stimulatus, Lumian, iam non affectus facultate Somniorum Horridorum, e somnio evigilavit.

source: He regained his senses, but his body remained numb.
target: Sensus suos recuperavit, sed corpus eius insensibile manebat.

source: He experienced this, as did Padre Cali.
target: Hoc experitus est, sicut et Padre Cali.

source: As soon as the Wraith regained consciousness, he instinctively detached from Lumian’s body to distance himself from the harm of the electric current.
target: Quam primum Wraith conscientiam recuperavit, instinctu se a corpore Lumiani separavit, ut a damno currentis electrici se distanseret.

source: His face materialized on the nearest pane of glass, his form indistinct.
target: Vultus eius in lamina vitrea proxima apparuit, forma eius indistincta.

source: Seizing the moment, Lumian donned the grayish-white, lightning-shaped brooch and retrieved his revolver from his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Occasionem captus, Lumian fibulam griseo-albam, fulminis similem, induit et revolverum suum e sacco Viatoris extraxit.

source: He raised his right hand, aiming at Wraith Cali, who remained in a daze.
target: Manum dexteram extulit, ad Wraith Cali destinans, qui in stupefacto manebat.

source: The Wraith’s various colors reflected in Lumian’s determined eyes.
target: Varii colores Wraith in oculis firmis Lumiani reflexerunt.

source: The pallor rapidly expanded in Lumian’s line of sight.
target: Pallor celeriter in conspectu Lumiani diffusus est.

source: Bang!
target: Bang!

source: Lumian calmly pulled the trigger, firing a yellow bullet.
target: Lumian tranquille trigerum premens, globulum flavum iacitavit.

source: As he did so, silver-white lightning flickered on the Fury of the Sea brooch, instantly entering the bullet and wrapping around its surface.
target: Dum hoc faciebat, fulgor argenteo-albus in fibula “Furor Maris” micuit, statim in globulum ingressus et superficiem eius circumvolvit.

source: This was one of the brooch’s abilities. It could grant the wearer an Electric Shock effect with every strike!
target: Hoc erat una ex virtutibus fibulae, quae induti ictum electricum cum omni ictu praestare poterat!

source: After temporarily losing the Pride Armor, this had become one of Lumian’s most effective methods against soul-type creatures.
target: Postquam armaturam Superbi temporarie amisit, hoc factum erat unum ex modis Lumiani efficacissimis contra creaturas animae generis.

source: The yellow bullet, engulfed in silver-white lightning, struck the stained-glass, shattering it and sending tiny electric currents in all directions.
target: Globulus flavus, fulgore argenteo-albo circumdatus, vitrum pictum percussit, confractum reddens et parvos currentes electricos in omnes partes diffudit.

source: However, it missed Padre Cali.
target: Attamen, Padre Cali non percussus est.

source: As Lumian pulled the trigger, the Wraith vanished from the glass and instantly leaped onto the glass-like surface of the crystal chandelier high above the cathedral.
target: Dum Lumian trigerum premens erat, Wraith ex vitreo evanuit et statim in superficiem vitream, quasi candelabri crystallini altae supra cathedralem, saliit.

source: Mirror Blink!
target: Speculum Micans!

source: On the other side, Rhea’s arrow struck Robert with precision, emitting a resounding bang like a heavy object colliding.
target: In altera parte, sagitta Rhea Robertum percussit cum praecisione, resonantem sonitum emittens, quasi grave obiectum collidens.

source: Crack!
target: Crack!

source: The ice armor covering Robert’s body instantly cracked, shattering into fragments that fell to the ground.
target: Armatura glacialis, quae corpus Roberti tegebat, statim fregit et in fragmenta dispersa resoluta cecidit.

source: Under the assault of crackling electric serpents, the blurry shadow attached to his body broke free and vanished into the void.
target: Sub impetu serpentium electricorum crepitantium, umbra confusa quae corpus eius adhaerebat, liberata est atque in nihilum evanuit.

source: With the ice armor shielding him from most of the damage, Robert remained relatively unaffected. However, his chest tightened, and his body briefly went numb.
target: Cum armatura glacialis eum ex plerisque damnis protegisset, Robertus relative intactus mansit; attamen, pectus eius contraxit et corpus eius per momentum insensibile factum est.

source: At that moment, he regretted not wearing clothes. The various ingredients needed for his spirit channeling were hidden in his clothes, such as Full Moon Essence Oil or Corpse Incense Medication.
target: Illo momento, paenitebat quod vestes non indutus esset; ingrediēntia varia, quae ad animam canali faciendam necessaria erant, in vestimentis eius celata erant, ut Oleum Essentiae Lunae Plenilunii aut Incensum Cadaveris Medicamentum.

source: There were very few spirits that could allow him to communicate safely without the use of materials. The one just now was the most powerful.
target: Pauci spiritus erant qui ei secure communicare sine usu materiārum sinere poterent; is qui modo apparuit potentissimus erat.

source: Seeing Camus’s special revolver and Rhea’s arrows aimed at him, Robert grew anxious.
target: Videns Camus revolverum specialem et sagittas Rhea ad se emissas, Robertus anxius factus est.

source: He thought of a spirit channeling method that could be completed under such circumstances.
target: Cogitavit de ratione ad animam canalizandam, quae talibus condicionibus perfici posset.

source: Frowning and fearing the pain, he bit the tip of his tongue.
target: Contristatus et dolorem metuens, apicem linguae suae mordit.

source: Pfft!
target: Pfft!

source: He spat out the blood from the tip of his tongue mixed with his saliva, emitting a strange sound from his throat.
target: Sanguinem ex apice linguae suae, cum salive mixta, expulsit et ex gutture suo sonum insolitum emisit.

source: A pair of weathered, stone-like hands reached out from beneath the cathedral’s stone bricks, seized Robert’s body, and pulled him underground.
target: Par manus lapideae vetustae, ex sub lateribus lapideis cathedralis eductae, corpus Roberti arripuerunt et eum subterraneum traxerunt.

source: At some point in time, the ground had softened like a swamp, and the blood in the air abruptly vanished.
target: Aliquando terra quasi paludis mollitate facta erat, et sanguis in aere subito evanuit.

source: Camus’s bullets and Rhea’s arrows arrived one after another, but they only caused sparks on the stone bricks on the ground.
target: Stipulae Camus et sagittae Rhea consecutim advenerunt, sed solum scintillas in lateribus lapideis terrae excitaverunt.

source: Spirit Medium? Camus used this opportunity to revise his judgment of Robert’s pathway and Sequence.
target: Spirit Medium? Camus hanc occasionem adhibuit ut iudicium de itinere et sequentia Roberti corrigeret.

source: He’s actually not from the same pathway as Miss Amandina?
target: Nonne revera non ex eadem via procedit quam Domina Amandina?

source: Hadn’t he also obtained his superpowers from the black boulder?
target: Nonne etiam ex saxo nigro super potestates suas consecutus est?

source: Camus hastily took a few steps back, retrieved a cartridge bag, and began reloading the revolver.
target: Camus celeriter paucos gradus retrorsum accessit, sacculum cartilaginum rapuit, et revolverum reficere coepit.

source: As a member of Matani’s authorities, obtaining Beyonder bullets with different effects was relatively easy, even though the patrol team wasn’t wealthy or had much accumulation.
target: Ut membrum auctoritatum Matani, obtinere globulos Beyonder cum diversis effectibus facile erat, quamquam manipulus vigiliae neque dives neque multa copiam habebat.

source: After all, there was the Eternal Blazing Sun Church, the God of Steam and Machinery Church, the Church of Earth Mother, and numerous adventurers coming and going.
target: Nam erant Ecclesia Aeternae Solis Ardoris, Ecclesia Dei Vaporis et Machinarum, Ecclesia Matris Terrae, ac plurimi viatores adventantes et abeuntes.

source: Furthermore, the patrol team needed to be vigilant against certain branches of the Rose School of Thought and the Numinous Episcopate. They had to make targeted preparations.
target: Praeterea, manipulus vigiliae contra certas factiones Scholae Rosae et Episcopatus Numinosi vigilantiam exercere oportebat, atque praeparationes destinatas facere debebat.

source: Camus swiftly inserted the golden Purifying Bullets into the revolver’s cylinder and snapped it shut.
target: Camus celeriter globulos aureos purificantes in cylindrum revolveri inseruit et statim illud clauserit.

source: At that moment, Padre Cali, who had leaped onto another stained‐glass window, reappeared.
target: Illo momento, Padre Cali, qui in aliam fenestram vitream insiluit, iterum apparuit.

source: He opened his mouth and emitted a piercing shriek that harmed one’s eardrums and Spirit Body.
target: Os suum aperuit et stridorem acutum exemit, qui auriculis et corpore spirituali laesit.

source: “Ah!”
target: “Ah!”

source: Wraith Shriek!
target: Stridor Wraith!
